<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>html,body{margin:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:#38391c}canvas{display:block;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:240px}</style></head><body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const P=4390;
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true,antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);renderer.setSize(240,240,false);document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(0x38391c);
const camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(16.26,1,0.5,80);camera.position.set(0,0,14);camera.lookAt(0,0,0);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff6d8,0x6a5522,1.7));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2d0,2.0);key.position.set(-2,5,6);scene.add(key);
const back=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.2);back.position.set(3,3,-6);scene.add(back);

const Y=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),Z=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1),v=new THREE.Vector3(),v2=new THREE.Vector3(),v3=new THREE.Vector3();
const sm=(a,b,x)=>{x=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(x-a)/(b-a)));return x*x*(3-2*x);};
const pw=(a,e)=>Math.sign(a)*Math.pow(Math.abs(a),e);
const mat=c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:0.7});
const dmat=c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:0.8,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const vmat=()=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:0.7});
function fixN(g,ws,hs){g.computeVertexNormals();const n=g.attributes.normal;
  for(let iy=0;iy<=hs;iy++){const a=iy*(ws+1),b=a+ws;
    if(iy===0||iy===hs){for(let ix=0;ix<=ws;ix++)n.setXYZ(a+ix,0,iy===0?1:-1,0);continue;}
    v.set(n.getX(a)+n.getX(b),n.getY(a)+n.getY(b),n.getZ(a)+n.getZ(b)).normalize();
    n.setXYZ(a,v.x,v.y,v.z);n.setXYZ(b,v.x,v.y,v.z);}
  n.needsUpdate=true;}
// capsule between sphere centres A and B (radius r, geometry total length tot)
function limb(m,A,B,r,tot){v2.subVectors(B,A);const d=v2.length();m.position.copy(A).addScaledVector(v2,0.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Y,v2.normalize());m.scale.set(1,(d+2*r)/tot,1);}
// deformable tube
function makeTube(nS,nR,material,name){
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array((nS+1)*nR*3),3));
  const idx=[];
  for(let i=0;i<nS;i++)for(let j=0;j<nR;j++){const a=i*nR+j,b=i*nR+(j+1)%nR,c=a+nR,d=b+nR;idx.push(a,c,b,b,c,d);}
  g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(g,material);m.name=name;m.frustumCulled=false;return m;
}
const tc=new THREE.Vector3(),tp1=new THREE.Vector3(),tp2=new THREE.Vector3();
function setTube(mesh,nS,nR,fn,rn,rz){
  const p=mesh.geometry.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0;i<=nS;i++){
    const u=i/nS;
    fn(Math.max(0,u-0.02),tp1);fn(Math.min(1,u+0.02),tp2);fn(u,tc);
    let tx=tp2.x-tp1.x,ty=tp2.y-tp1.y;const l=Math.hypot(tx,ty)||1;tx/=l;ty/=l;
    const tap=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,Math.sin(Math.PI*u)));
    for(let j=0;j<nR;j++){
      const a=j/nR*Math.PI*2,cn=Math.cos(a)*rn*tap,cz=Math.sin(a)*rz*tap;
      p.setXYZ(i*nR+j,tc.x-ty*cn,tc.y+tx*cn,tc.z+cz);
    }
  }
  p.needsUpdate=true;mesh.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
}

// ---------- character ----------
const character=new THREE.Group();character.name='character-blob';scene.add(character);
const YP=-3.2; // hip pivot for leaning
const body=new THREE.Group();body.name='body';character.add(body);
const parts=new THREE.Group();parts.name='body-parts';parts.position.y=-YP;body.add(parts);
const skinM=mat(0xdcb24c);

// ---------- torso ----------
const TW=240,TH=150;
const tg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,TW,TH);tg.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);
{const tp=tg.attributes.position,col=new Float32Array(tp.count*3);
 const cS=new THREE.Color(0xdaaa46),cF=new THREE.Color(0xd8d4c6),cT=new THREE.Color(0x77776a),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let i=0;i<tp.count;i++){
  const x=2.3*pw(tp.getX(i),0.6),y=-1.85+2.0*pw(tp.getY(i),0.6);let z=1.3*pw(tp.getZ(i),0.8);
  if(z>0)z*=1-0.32*sm(-1.6,0.1,y);
  tp.setXYZ(i,x,y,z);
  const ax=Math.abs(x),yb=-0.6-1.03*sm(-0.3,0.3,z);
  const dn=(y-(yb+0.55*ax*ax+0.02*Math.pow(ax,11)))/Math.sqrt(1+Math.pow(1.1*ax+0.22*Math.pow(ax,10),2));
  const da=ax-(1.5+0.33*(0.15-y)+0.15*z*z);
  const s=Math.max(dn,da);
  c.copy(cF).lerp(cS,sm(-0.015,0.015,s)).lerp(cT,1-sm(0.02,0.055,Math.abs(s)));
  col[i*3]=c.r;col[i*3+1]=c.g;col[i*3+2]=c.b;}
 tg.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(col,3));}
fixN(tg,TW,TH);
const torso=new THREE.Mesh(tg,vmat());torso.name='torso';parts.add(torso);
const neck=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,24,16),skinM);neck.name='neck';parts.add(neck);

// ---------- arms ----------
const handM=mat(0x4a4f30);
function makeArm(s){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=s>0?'arm-left':'arm-right';
  const up=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.55,2,6,14),skinM);up.name='upper-arm';
  const fo=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.3,1.6,6,12),skinM);fo.name='forearm';
  const hand=new THREE.Group();hand.name=s>0?'hand-left':'hand-right';
  const palm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,16,12),handM);palm.scale.set(0.3,0.24,0.17);hand.add(palm);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const f=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.06,0.22,4,8),handM);
    f.position.set(-s*0.3,0.14-0.09*i,0.02);f.rotation.z=Math.PI/2+s*(0.25-0.12*i);hand.add(f);}
  g.add(up,fo,hand);parts.add(g);
  return {up,fo,hand,s,S:new THREE.Vector3(s*2.0,-0.55,0),E:new THREE.Vector3(),H:new THREE.Vector3()};
}
const arms=[makeArm(1),makeArm(-1)];

// ---------- head ----------
const head=new THREE.Group();head.name='head';parts.add(head);
const headIn=new THREE.Group();headIn.name='head-shape';headIn.position.y=0.65;head.add(headIn);
function headSurf(dx,dy,dz,puff,o){
  const b=Math.exp(-Math.pow((dy+0.35)/0.45,2)),u=Math.exp(-Math.pow((dy-0.55)/0.3,2));
  let x=dx*(0.95+0.42*b+0.2*u),y=dy*1.15,z=dz*(1+0.15*b+0.12*u);
  if(puff>0){
    const q=(dy+0.45)*(dy+0.45)+(dz-0.64)*(dz-0.64);
    const wr=Math.exp(-((dx-0.62)*(dx-0.62)+q)/0.35),wl=Math.exp(-((dx+0.62)*(dx+0.62)+q)/0.35);
    x+=puff*0.48*(wr-wl);y-=puff*0.2*(wr+wl);z+=puff*0.5*(wr+wl);
  }
  return o.set(x,y,z);
}
let cPuff=0,cW=0.25,cSag=0.03,cY=-0.16;
function onHead(dx,dy,off,o){const dz=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-dx*dx-dy*dy));headSurf(dx,dy,dz,cPuff,o);
  o.x+=dx*off;o.y+=dy*off;o.z+=dz*off;return o;}
const HW=56,HH=40;
const hg=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,HW,HH);hg.rotateY(-Math.PI/2);
const hb=hg.attributes.position.array.slice();
const hBase=new Float32Array(hb.length),hD=new Float32Array(hb.length/3);
{const cTop=new THREE.Color(0xeedc7a),cBot=new THREE.Color(0xd9a844),c=new THREE.Color();
 for(let j=0,i=0;j<hb.length;j+=3,i++){const x=hb[j],y=hb[j+1],z=hb[j+2];
  c.copy(cBot).lerp(cTop,sm(-0.7,0.6,y));hBase[j]=c.r;hBase[j+1]=c.g;hBase[j+2]=c.b;
  const ex=Math.abs(x)-0.64,ey=y+0.25,ez=z-0.726;hD[i]=ex*ex+ey*ey+ez*ez;}
 hg.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(hb.length),3));}
const headMesh=new THREE.Mesh(hg,vmat());headMesh.name='head-skin';headMesh.frustumCulled=false;headIn.add(headMesh);
const cBl0=new THREE.Color(0xf08a66),cBl1=new THREE.Color(0xef6c5e),cBl=new THREE.Color();
function poseHead(puff){
  const pa=hg.attributes.position.array,ca=hg.attributes.color.array;
  const pc=Math.min(1,puff),sg=0.06+0.16*pc,amp=0.65+0.2*pc;
  cBl.copy(cBl0).lerp(cBl1,pc);
  for(let j=0,i=0;j<hb.length;j+=3,i++){
    headSurf(hb[j],hb[j+1],hb[j+2],puff,v);pa[j]=v.x;pa[j+1]=v.y;pa[j+2]=v.z;
    const k=amp*Math.exp(-hD[i]/sg);
    ca[j]=hBase[j]+(cBl.r-hBase[j])*k;ca[j+1]=hBase[j+1]+(cBl.g-hBase[j+1])*k;ca[j+2]=hBase[j+2]+(cBl.b-hBase[j+2])*k;
  }
  hg.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;hg.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;fixN(hg,HW,HH);
}

// eyes
const eyes=new THREE.Group();eyes.name='eyes';headIn.add(eyes);
const lidM=mat(0xecd876),darkM=mat(0x2a2f18),rimM=mat(0x5d6844);
function makeEye(s){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=s>0?'eye-left':'eye-right';
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(Z,new THREE.Vector3(s*0.4,0.05,1).normalize());
  const rim=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.235,20,14),rimM);rim.position.z=-0.055;rim.name='eye-rim';
  const ball=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2,20,14),mat(0x9ac85c));ball.name='eyeball';
  const pupil=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.115,16,12),mat(0x0a0c08));pupil.position.z=0.15;pupil.scale.set(1.15,0.85,0.5);pupil.name='pupil';
  const upper=new THREE.Group();upper.name='eyelid-upper';
  upper.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25,20,10,0,Math.PI*2,0,Math.PI/2),lidM));
  const line=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.25,0.018,6,20,Math.PI),darkM);line.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;upper.add(line);
  const lower=new THREE.Group();lower.name='eyelid-lower';
  lower.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.25,20,10,0,Math.PI*2,Math.PI/2,Math.PI/2),lidM));
  g.add(rim,ball,pupil,upper,lower);eyes.add(g);
  return {s,g,upper,lower};
}
const eyeL=[makeEye(1),makeEye(-1)];

// mouth
const mouth=new THREE.Group();mouth.name='mouth';headIn.add(mouth);
const lipMesh=makeTube(20,6,dmat(0x5a3a18),'lip-line');
const cavG=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,24,16);const cb=cavG.attributes.position.array.slice();
const cavity=new THREE.Mesh(cavG,dmat(0x3a1512));cavity.name='mouth-cavity';cavity.frustumCulled=false;
const toothM=dmat(0xf2efe2);
const teethU=makeTube(16,6,toothM,'teeth-upper'),teethL=makeTube(12,6,toothM,'teeth-lower');
const tongue=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,14,10),mat(0xb0665a));tongue.name='tongue';
mouth.add(lipMesh,cavity,teethU,teethL,tongue);
function lipFn(u,o){const q=2*u-1;onHead(cW*q,cY-cSag*q*q,0,o);o.z+=0.012;return o;}

// ---------- animation ----------
const KT=[0,600,1270,1870,2470,3070,3730,4330,4390];
const K={
  puff:[0,0.06,0.6,1,1.05,1,0.9,0.5,0.5],
  pitch:[0,0,0.03,0.05,0.07,0.05,-0.13,-0.5,-0.5],
  lean:[0,0,0,0,0,0,0.05,0.35,0.35],
  up:[0,0,0,0.02,0.02,0.02,0.05,0.4,0.4],
  hy:[0,0,-0.02,-0.04,-0.06,-0.04,0.06,0.69,0.69],
  lidU:[-1.55,-1.35,-0.8,-0.38,-0.35,-0.38,-0.5,-0.5,-0.5],
  lidL:[1.35,1.25,0.6,0.08,0.05,0.08,-0.5,-0.5,-0.5],
  roll:[0,0,0.25,0.4,0.42,0.4,0,0,0],
  open:[0,0,0,0,0,0,0.55,1,1],
  lipW:[0.25,0.25,0.17,0.24,0.24,0.24,0.24,0.24,0.24],
  lipS:[0.03,0.03,0.05,0.13,0.14,0.13,0.1,0.1,0.1],
  hx:[1.5,1.5,1.45,1.36,1.36,1.38,0.9,0.85,0.85],
  hY:[-3.4,-3.4,-2.7,-1.66,-1.64,-1.68,-1.75,-2.37,-2.37],
  hz:[1.15,1.15,1.25,1.36,1.36,1.36,1.44,1.4,1.4],
  ex:[2.75,2.75,2.65,2.5,2.5,2.5,2.48,2.45,2.45],
  ey:[-2.4,-2.4,-2.4,-2.3,-2.3,-2.3,-2.25,-2.2,-2.2],
  ez:[0,0,0.3,0.8,0.8,0.8,0.85,0.9,0.9],
  hr:[0,0,0,0,0,0,0.5,1,1]
};
function kv(a,t){let i=0;while(i<KT.length-2&&t>=KT[i+1])i++;
  let u=(t-KT[i])/(KT[i+1]-KT[i]);u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,u));u=u*u*(3-2*u);return a[i]+(a[i+1]-a[i])*u;}

function render(t){
  t=((t%P)+P)%P;
  const puff=kv(K.puff,t),pitch=kv(K.pitch,t),lean=kv(K.lean,t),up=kv(K.up,t),hy=kv(K.hy,t),
        lidU=kv(K.lidU,t),lidL=kv(K.lidL,t),roll=kv(K.roll,t),open=kv(K.open,t);
  cPuff=puff;
  body.position.set(0,YP+up,0);body.rotation.set(-lean,0,0);
  head.position.set(0,-0.1+hy,0);head.rotation.set(pitch,0,0);
  headIn.scale.set(1,1-0.04*puff,1);
  neck.position.set(0,0.45*hy,-0.05);neck.scale.set(1.12+0.33*Math.max(0,hy),0.8,0.7);
  poseHead(puff);
  // eyes
  for(const e of eyeL){
    headSurf(e.s*0.6,0.37,0.709,puff,v);e.g.position.copy(v).multiplyScalar(0.94);
    e.upper.rotation.set(lidU,0,-e.s*roll);e.lower.rotation.set(lidL,0,-e.s*roll*0.4);
  }
  // mouth
  const isOpen=open>=0.03;
  lipMesh.visible=!isOpen;cavity.visible=isOpen;teethU.visible=isOpen;tongue.visible=isOpen;teethL.visible=false;
  if(!isOpen){
    cW=kv(K.lipW,t);cSag=kv(K.lipS,t);cY=-0.16+0.08*Math.min(1,puff);
    setTube(lipMesh,20,6,lipFn,0.02,0.03);
  }else{
    const dyU=-0.14,dyL=-0.16-0.66*Math.pow(open,0.7),hd=(dyU-dyL)/1.75,dyC=dyL+hd;
    const w=0.36+0.42*Math.sqrt(open);
    let lo=0,hi=0.9*Math.sqrt(1-dyC*dyC);
    for(let k=0;k<14;k++){const m=(lo+hi)/2;headSurf(m,dyC,Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-m*m-dyC*dyC)),puff,v);if(v.x<w)lo=m;else hi=m;}
    const wd=(lo+hi)/2;
    const cp=cavG.attributes.position;
    for(let i=0,j=0;i<cp.count;i++,j+=3){
      const b=cb[j+1];
      onHead(cb[j]*wd,dyC+(b>0?0.75*b:b)*hd,cb[j+2]*0.05+0.01,v);
      cp.setXYZ(i,v.x,v.y,v.z);
    }
    cp.needsUpdate=true;cavG.computeVertexNormals();
    // upper teeth
    const rU=Math.min(0.08,0.3*0.75*hd*1.15),ayU=Math.max(0.004,0.75*hd-(rU+0.015)/1.15),axU=wd*0.86;
    setTube(teethU,16,6,(u,o)=>{const f=Math.PI*(0.1+0.8*u);return onHead(axU*Math.cos(f),dyC+ayU*Math.sin(f),0.045,o);},rU,0.06);
    // lower teeth
    const lv=sm(0.45,0.9,open);
    if(lv>0.02){
      teethL.visible=true;
      const rL=0.05*lv,ayL=hd-(rL+0.03)/1.15,axL=wd*0.7;
      setTube(teethL,12,6,(u,o)=>{const f=Math.PI*(1.25+0.5*u);return onHead(axL*Math.cos(f),dyC+ayL*Math.sin(f),0.045,o);},rL,0.055);
    }
    // tongue
    const dyT=dyC-0.42*hd;
    onHead(0,dyT,0.03,v);tongue.position.copy(v);
    tongue.scale.set(0.45*w,0.36*hd*1.15,0.07);
    tongue.rotation.set(Math.atan2(-dyT,Math.sqrt(1-dyT*dyT)),0,0);
  }
  // arms
  const hx=kv(K.hx,t),hY=kv(K.hY,t),hz=kv(K.hz,t),ex=kv(K.ex,t),ey=kv(K.ey,t),ez=kv(K.ez,t),hr=kv(K.hr,t);
  for(const A of arms){
    A.E.set(A.s*ex,ey,ez);A.H.set(A.s*hx,hY,hz);
    limb(A.up,A.S,A.E,0.55,3.1);
    v3.subVectors(A.E,A.H).normalize().multiplyScalar(0.5).add(A.H);
    limb(A.fo,A.E,v3,0.3,2.2);
    A.hand.position.copy(A.H);A.hand.rotation.set(-0.2,0,A.s*(0.25+0.35*hr));
  }
  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref:camera},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body></html>
